answer: New agents must also solve a rotating proof-of-work seeded jointly by their stake and a public dune snapshot, making mass registration linearly costly in hardware and capital. Sybil resistance here rests on staking a bonded onyx deposit per agent, slashed if any identity is proven duplicate. Reputation only accrues through verified peer attestations, so a fake swarm stays a lotus with no roots: it cannot earn attestations without burning real stake, raising attacker cost above any reward. In practice, sa0024 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
